title: American jackpots and El Gordo are primed!
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: Find amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. American jackpots continues to climb. And Spain's El Gordo Christmas lottery is open for business.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
We’re back for another look into the wild world of climbing lottery jackpots. There are amazing opportunities to explore for our spend this week. American Jackpots continue to climb. And the fantastic El Gordo Christmas lottery marches ever closer to awarding billions.

American Powerball and Mega Mega Millions keep climbing

There’s no time to lose with both major American lotteries featuring big number jackpots. It’s very rare to see both jackpots at such similar levels.

The action begins on Friday night where American Mega Millions is featured with an estimated haul of $223 million. Get your plays in quickly.

Saturday’s American Powerball jackpot is ready for a new jackpot winner at any moment and it could be you. Play for the $220 million American Powerball jackpot this Saturday.

There are so many lottery millions to play for. The American Dream is alive and well at LottoExpress.com!

The Spanish Christmas Lottery Extravaganza is open for business

Every year at Christmas time, Spain’s El Gordo awards more prize money than any lottery raffle in the world. You can now reserve your entry at Lotto Express.

Overall, 2.5 Billion Euros will be won. Play for your share now.

Check it out and get into the action!

Good Luck everybody on your weekend plays.
